verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents a few specific features that run on their own once configured: recurring Pix collection after a single authorization, automatic splitting of inbound funds as they arrive, and automated reconciliation. Scheduled Pix/TED transfers are one-off scheduled actions, not recurring automations, and there is no evidence of a general automation, rules, or workflow engine. Webhooks are only developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or rules engine, recurring scheduled outbound actions, documentation of how background automations are set up and monitored, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Receive recurring payments through Pix after a one-time authorization
Split inbound funds across multiple parties at the moment they arrive
Receive and manage your online sales with accuracy and automated reconciliation.
